props.text: Ready to find the right equipment for your business?

Visit us at our convenient locations across Central and Southwest Florida. Every dealership carries sales, parts and service departments, with dedicated trailer repair bays, an aftermarket facility in Tampa and a parts store in Brooksville. After-hours service is available through Certified Fleet, and our mobile service team comes to you.

values.heading: Coverage outside store hours.
values.body:
Certified Fleet provides after-hours support from 5:00 PM to 8:00 AM at our Tampa, Davenport and Sarasota locations, so help is available when a truck goes down overnight.

Our mobile service team runs Monday–Friday, 8 AM – 5 PM from all three dealerships and performs many repairs, diagnostics and preventative maintenance at your yard or job site.

items.title: Truck sales
items.body: New and used International trucks, IC Bus and Capacity yard trucks at Tampa, Davenport and Sarasota.

items.title: Trailer sales
items.body: New and used Hyundai Translead and Globe Trailers through Sun State Trailers in Tampa.

items.title: Parts
items.body: Parts counters at all three dealerships plus Brooksville Truck & Trailer Parts and Sun State Aftermarket Parts in Tampa.

items.title: Service & aftermarket
items.body: Truck and trailer service bays in Tampa, Davenport and Sarasota; body, hoist and frame work at the Tampa aftermarket facility.

items.q: How many Sun State locations are there?
items.a: Six: full dealerships in Tampa, Davenport and Sarasota, Truck & Trailer Parts in Brooksville, Sun State Aftermarket Parts in Tampa, and Sun State Trailers Trailer Sales in Tampa.

items.q: What are the service department hours?
items.a: Tampa and Davenport service run 7 AM to 7 PM Monday through Friday and 7 AM to 12 PM Saturday. Sarasota service runs 7 AM to 5 PM Monday through Friday. After-hours service is available via Certified Fleet from 5 PM to 8 AM.

Sun State Trailers Trailer Sales is at 6020 E Adamo Dr in Tampa, open 8 AM to 5 PM Monday through Friday. Trailer parts and service are available in Tampa, Davenport and Sarasota, and trailer parts are also stocked in Brooksville.

items.q: Where do I go for aftermarket modifications?
items.a: Sun State Aftermarket Parts at 7105 East 6th Ave, Tampa, FL 33619, open 7 AM to 4 PM Monday through Friday. Call (813) 627-3282.

items.q: Do you offer curbside pickup or delivery?
items.a: The Tampa, Davenport and Sarasota dealerships offer in-store shopping and curbside pickup. The Brooksville, Aftermarket and Trailer Sales locations offer in-store shopping, in-store pickup and delivery.

Our locations serve Tampa, Sarasota, Davenport and Brooksville along with St. Petersburg, Lakeland, Orlando, Bradenton and the rest of Central and Southwest Florida, plus mobile service at your yard or job site.

values.heading: Ready to get on the road?
values.body: Contact us to explore our trucks and trailers and experience nothing less than the dedicated care you deserve.
